findings.problem: Authoritative arithmetic must remain independent from model strings and locale week defaults.
findings.evidence: calendarPolicy.ts/timezonePolicy.ts controlled-clock tests; Temporal disambiguation rejects DST folds/gaps.

findings.problem: Follow-up terminology could imply a repeated AI conversation.
findings.evidence: resolutionRequirements and explicit deterministic form gate; compatibility names retained without new model calls.

findings.problem: Simple extraction issued 17 independent questions and 2626 input tokens in one development example; optimize only after calibrated correctness.
findings.evidence: Source-only exclusion path skips seven unused vehicle questions; deterministic parser/extraction regression proves equivalent source constraint. Live efficiency/latency impact remains unmeasured.

findings.problem: Approximate clock suffix was incorrectly retained inside a destination candidate and excluded from temporal observation.
findings.evidence: Generator v4: bare/approximate clocks and clearly marked zoned-clock/date-daypart suffixes stay outside endpoint spans. Shared timezone lexer preserves trusted location masking; controlled-clock parser regression verifies the UTC instant.

findings.problem: EXPLICIT_ANY plus REQUIRED strength was inconsistent for a query containing only a vehicle exclusion.
findings.evidence: Deterministic source-only EXCLUDED rule dominates inconsistent positive choices. All-class exclusions and positive/negative conflicts still require form resolution. Tests cover twenty inconsistent provider-choice combinations.

findings.problem: One synthetic live exclusion query failed strict SDK response validation before extraction.
findings.evidence: Historical prefix manifest retained five SDK/adapter rejections and five source-binding failures. Current manifest records 3 incomplete SDK/adapter requests / 261 attempted requests; completed responses can also fail deterministic source binding. No failed attempt was erased or retried for a better answer. Luna recovery remains unmeasured.
findings.rationale: Strict SDK validation rejects invalid responses; no schema tolerance, location invention, booking or consequence bypass. Failed attempts remain measured. This intermittent unavailable parse affects availability, not silent interpretation. Full live development must include provider failures before interpretation signoff.
findings.freezeBoundary: No known static HIGH/CRITICAL. Complete development execution and AI disposition remain mandatory before freeze; deferral is not a waiver of those gates.
findings.providerWorkNeeded: Measure strict SDK failures and one-shot fallback recovery in remaining development, preserving failed attempts; do not relax schema.
findings.heldOutImpact: Intermittent provider rejection can reduce completion/accuracy. Strict validation contains silent malformed output; systematic failures block interpretation signoff.

findings.problem: Labelled destination clauses and comma-delimited vehicle exclusions could be swallowed into geographic candidates, masking independently stated vehicle/time evidence.
findings.evidence: Deterministic candidate boundary patch and source-provenance regression. Frozen labels/split untouched. Current generator coverage 100%; live system benchmark remains unmeasured.

findings.problem: Live development found three SIMPLE routes choosing the last conflicting time because candidates masked the earlier time/date; explicit on-date tails were also masked.
findings.evidence: Shared lexer boundary helper and forced incorrect-SIMPLE/last-time provider regression preserve both clocks and require fallback. Frozen labels and guard unchanged. Current live source rerun remains required.

findings.problem: Two live development cases silently selected the last clock because numeric Gate/Sector address markers adjacent to tomorrow were recognized as clocks before the actual competing time suffix.
findings.evidence: Bounded landmark-number filter preserves Gate/Sector/Block/Terminal/Platform numbers without suppressing explicitly marked clock expressions. Numbered-location, explicit-clock, unrelated-landmark and whitespace regressions pass; current live rerun pending.

findings.problem: Leading courtesy widened pickup spans; bounded routing misread numbered place names and unrelated information.
findings.evidence: Original eight failures corrected in the preserved prefix-development run. Current-source 131/222 attempted stage and UTF-16/provenance/prefix witnesses are recorded. Completed routing 113/113, pickup 76/76. Full-system availability not passed.

findings.problem: A closed explicit passenger/flag tail could remain in a geographic candidate and mask supplied booking components.
findings.evidence: Recognized closed passenger tails reuse existing observations; unknown words are preserved. Controlled offline source/date/time/flag and prior-reference witnesses pass; changed production coverage 100%, current mutation registry has zero meaningful survivors.

findings.problem: Five validly shaped live responses invented a vehicle exclusion not supported by the source query.
findings.evidence: Five historical invented vehicle exclusions were rejected by source binding. Current source attempted 131/222; 113 interpretations complete, 17 Luna pending, 1 Places pending, 91 unattempted. Full recovery is unmeasured.
findings.rationale: Current invariant guards contain the failure. This is an availability/interpretation-completion gap, not permission to weaken source binding or choose a favorable repeated answer.
findings.freezeBoundary: No known static HIGH/CRITICAL. Complete development execution and AI disposition remain mandatory before freeze; deferral is not a waiver of those gates.
findings.providerWorkNeeded: Complete remaining current-config interpretations and measure fallback recovery; retain historical raw exclusion errors and source guards.
findings.heldOutImpact: Unsupported raw exclusions can impair accuracy/completion. No silent adopted exclusion was observed; source binding remains mandatory.

findings.problem: Six newly completed development parses swallowed punctuation-introduced safe-route/carrier/sharing clauses into destination spans and masked their supplied flags.
findings.evidence: Closed-tail clipping reuses supported observations, admits only a passenger introducer or flag after comma/semicolon, and preserves unknown text. Current completed flag accuracy 113/113; drop spans 69/69. Scoped tests cover Unicode, negative flags, multiple carriers, whitespace and unsupported/unknown tails. Coverage 100%; changed-source mutation reconciliation has zero meaningful survivors.

findings.problem: Seven historical responses identified booking intent but answered complexity NOT_APPLICABLE for incomplete vehicle requests or a single route with an exclusion.
findings.evidence: The independent complexity question names incomplete vehicle requests and single routes with exclusions as SIMPLE and reserves NOT_APPLICABLE for place-only/unrelated input. Current question-module mutations are reconciled by source identity. Provider failures remain included in development counts.

findings.problem: Three completed historical parses softened unqualified required vehicle classes to preferences.
findings.evidence: Strength is bound to explicit source wording: an unqualified class is required; stated softening is preferred; only retains precedence. Contradictory provider strength produces recorded fallback. Whitespace and source-provenance witnesses pass.

findings.problem: Six completed historical parses lost explicit ANY vehicle acceptance through irrelevant model uncertainty.
findings.evidence: Literal positive any car/cab/vehicle with no competing class retains source references and omits unused vehicle questions. Negated, competing and generic acceptance remain on the bounded decision path. Current completed vehicle accuracy 113/113; current mutations are reconciled by source identity.

findings.problem: Google Places quota stopped the current development run before all 222 records could be attempted.
findings.evidence: 131/222 cases attempted; 1 Places-blocked case and 91 unattempted. PLACES_QUOTA is retained in the stopped run. No retry timestamp was reported. No retry was made.
findings.rationale: Resume only after Places availability is restored and a small preflight succeeds. Preserve this failure and complete only missing current-config work. No model-controlled Places, automatic selection or synthetic success replaces the provider response.
findings.freezeBoundary: No known static HIGH/CRITICAL. Complete development execution and AI disposition remain mandatory before freeze; deferral is not a waiver of those gates.
findings.providerWorkNeeded: One small availability preflight only after Places restoration is independently established, then complete missing grounding/current-config work; no automatic quota probing.
findings.heldOutImpact: Places quota prevents complete grounding and final selected-place evaluation. It does not alter benchmark labels or permit a fabricated success.
